newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic's McCann forms Ukraine venture.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic's McCann forms Ukraine venture.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc.'s McCann-Erickson unit said Friday it formed a partnership in Ukraine with the advertising agency Linea 12.
The deal extends McCann's network in Eastern Europe, where it was already ranked as the largest agency, according to Advertising Age, with billings of $114 million last year.
Linea 12 has billings of about $1 million, making it one of the largest agencies in Kiev, with clients that include Mastercard, AT&T and RJ Reynolds.
McCann said that its billings in Eastern Europe in 1996 should reach almost $200 million.
